findings.current:
“Make way…!”

The towering Grand Mage caught his breath, then shouted like a roar.

“Make way!”
findings.defect: “Make way” tells others to step aside; Johnson orders the force to open a path through the enemy.
findings.rationale: 길을 열어라 directs the fighters to clear a route toward their Alliance Leader.
findings.replacement:
“Clear a…!”

The towering Grand Mage caught his breath, then shouted like a roar.

“Clear a path!”
findings.source:
“길을……!”

가쁜 호흡을 삼킨 거구의 대마도사가, 이내 포효하듯 외쳤다.

“길을 열어라!”

findings.current: A dense cloud of steam rose, covering the area and blocking the battlefield from view.
findings.defect: The draft omits the cloud’s roughly hundred-meter radius.
findings.rationale: 반경 백여 미터 specifies how far the steam spreads.
findings.replacement: A dense cloud of steam rose, spreading across a radius of roughly a hundred meters and blocking the view in every direction.
findings.source: 반경 백여 미터를 뒤덮을 만큼 자욱한 수증기가 피어올라 사방의 시야를 가렸다.

findings.current: At the same time, countless pairs of bloodshot eyes gleamed ominously from within the dark rift in space.
findings.defect: “Bloodshot” adds a physical detail absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 안광 describes the ominous gleam of eyes, not their redness.
findings.replacement: At the same time, countless eyes gleamed ominously from within the dark rift in space.
findings.source: 그와 동시에 어두컴컴한 공간의 틈새로, 무수히 많은 안광(眼光)이 흉흉하게 번뜩였다.

summary: The draft changes a battlefield order and adds an unsupported visual detail; it also omits the extent of the steam cloud.
